integrity: Self-contained support-function proof and a standard-library exact finite checker. Scientific conclusions have been internally reviewed; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real scalar field; finite simple graph with at least one edge; every coefficient strictly between zero and one; the formula does not cover endpoint coefficients, complex scalar extensions, or hyperedges. title: Graph parity determines exact generating radii of positive edge averages
